task_intent: Refine Tessera clock and everyday light routines with clear native controls and faithful wall previews.

references.applied: Give time a calm, uncluttered visual field. Keep controls outside the actual wall artwork and preserve its oversized hour/minute hierarchy.
A watch-face sized composition can stay distinctive through oversized stacked numerals, with readable format examples below the artwork.
Keep an active countdown prominent and its single stop/cancel action visually separate from duration setup.
Use a focused active state with generous numeric scale and an unmistakable end action; do not leave competing start controls visible during a timer.
Use a native time wheel and an explicit save step for a device-side daily alarm. Keep the wall's timezone visible and retain draft changes until acknowledgement.
Make the alarm's enabled state readable beside its time. Keep the daily cadence explicit rather than adding unsupported weekday controls.
Use direct format choices for the short 12/24-hour list and the native multipart time picker for alarm hour/minute editing.
Display send acknowledgement and retry errors inline in the current workspace; no second customization modal or disruptive success alert.

references.source: Apple Support · Set an alarm in Clock on iPhone
references.applied: Keep the alarm time and enabled state distinct from the wake-light routine. Clearly label Tessera's wall-based visual alarm.
